finding.summary: Uncommitted changes in src/ or eval/promptfoo/ only produce a warning but allow the run to proceed. This creates a mismatch between the commit hash recorded in run.json and the actual code executing, violating test–production parity.
finding.fix: Either exit with an error on uncommitted changes (recommended for reproducibility), or add a --force flag to override. Example: [[ -n "$(git -C "$AGENT" status --porcelain -- src eval/promptfoo)" ]] && { echo "ERROR: uncommitted changes..." >&2; exit 1; }

label: real_issue
label_reason: Commit 02d37e7 in the PR cites finding R45-fee8a9a-015.
